story.title: Our Story
paragraphs: We are a Paraguayan store with over 7 years of experience in camping, fishing, automotive and motorcycle gear.
What started as a small venture in Mariano Roque Alonso grew thanks to the trust of our customers who seek quality products for their adventures.
Today we offer a wide range of products: from camping tents and fishing rods to motorcycle accessories and rural equipment. All in one place.
Our mission is simple: help you find the right gear so you can enjoy every adventure to the fullest.

seo.title: FAQ - El Viajero | Frequently Asked Questions
seo.description: Answers to the most common questions about our products, orders, shipping, payments and returns.

items.question: How do I place an order?
items.answer: You can order directly through WhatsApp. Browse our catalog, pick your products, and send us a message with your order. We'll confirm availability and arrange delivery.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept cash, bank transfer, Mercado Pago, Bancard, and credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard). We also offer 3, 6 and 12 interest-free installments.

items.question: Do you deliver across Paraguay?
items.answer: Yes! We deliver in the metropolitan area and to all of Paraguay. Contact us for shipping costs and estimated delivery time.

items.question: What is your return policy?
items.answer: You can return or exchange products within 7 days of purchase. The product must be in its original packaging and unused. Contact us to arrange the return.

items.question: Do you offer warranties?
items.answer: Yes, all our products come with a warranty. The warranty period varies by product and brand. Contact us for specific warranty information.

items.question: Can I visit your physical store?
items.answer: Of course! We're located in Mariano Roque Alonso, on Coronel Felipe Toledo Street in Barrio La Concordia. Our hours are Mon-Fri 08:00-19:00, Sat 08:00-17:00, Sun 09:00-13:00.

items.question: How can I check product availability?
items.answer: Send us a WhatsApp message with the product name and we'll check stock availability for you right away.

items.question: Do you offer discounts for bulk purchases?
items.answer: Yes, we offer special pricing for bulk orders. Contact us and we'll put together a custom quote.
